story_info.title: Oliver Fox and the High Pebble
story_info.subtitle: A story about helping friends
story_info.moral: Helping friends and working together makes problems easier.

main_character.name: Oliver Fox
main_character.appearance: Oliver is a slim young fox with bright orange-red fur, a fluffy white-tipped tail, and perky triangular ears. He has clever amber eyes and a playful, confident grin.

supporting_characters.name: Pip Sparrow
supporting_characters.appearance: A small brown sparrow with bright, curious eyes and tiny grey wings.
supporting_characters.role: Needs help getting her favourite pebble and teams up with Oliver.

slides.title: A Sad Friend
slides.text: Oliver Fox loved sunny mornings. He walked into Blossom Meadow. Bright flowers grew tall and colourful. Oliver saw his friend, Pip Sparrow. Pip looked a little sad. Her tiny head was down. Oliver went to say hello. "What is wrong, Pip?" he asked kindly. "Let's solve it together!"
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver Fox finds his friend Pip Sparrow looking sad in Blossom Meadow.

slides.title: The High Pebble
slides.text: Pip pointed a tiny wing. "My shiny pebble," she chirped. "It is stuck way up high. In that very tall flower." Oliver looked up at the big flower. The beautiful pebble sparkled bright. It was Pip's most favourite thing. Oliver knew he had to help his good friend.
slides.speaker_notes: Pip explains her problem to Oliver: her favourite shiny pebble is stuck high in a tall flower.

slides.title: A Clever Idea
slides.text: Oliver jumped up high. He stretched his paw. But the flower was too tall to reach. "Hmm," Oliver thought. He looked all around the meadow. "I have an idea, Pip!" he said with a grin. "We can work together! Let's find a long, strong stick." Pip's eyes lit up.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver tries to reach the pebble but it's too high. He gets a clever idea to work with Pip using a stick.

slides.title: Teamwork Time
slides.text: Oliver and Pip looked for a big stick. Oliver found a perfect one. It was long and strong. Oliver held the stick up high. He aimed it carefully at the tall flower. "Now, Pip!" he said softly. Pip flew onto the stick. She walked very carefully up. Up, up, up she went!
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver and Pip find a long stick. Oliver holds it steady while Pip carefully climbs up.

slides.title: Happy Friends
slides.text: Pip reached the top. Her tiny beak gently picked up the shiny pebble. Then she flew back down to Oliver. "Hooray!" cheered Oliver. Pip dropped the pebble safely into her nest. "Thank you, Oliver!" she chirped. "You are such a good friend!" Oliver smiled. "Working together made it easy, Pip!" he said. Sharing problems makes friends feel happy. It also makes their friendship very strong.
slides.speaker_notes: Pip successfully retrieves her pebble. Oliver and Pip celebrate, feeling happy about their teamwork and strong friendship.

instagram.caption: What a lovely morning in Wonderwood Valley! Oliver Fox, our funny and creative fox, is enjoying the bright flowers in Blossom Meadow. But then he spots his friend, Pip Sparrow, looking a little sad. Pip's most treasured shiny pebble is caught in a tall flower, and she can't reach it! Oliver, with his brave and friendly heart, knows just what to say: 'Let's solve it together!' Watch as Oliver and Pip learn how teamwork and friendship can make even the trickiest problems easy and fun. This sweet story reminds us that helping our friends builds strong connections and brings so much joy. Share this adventure with your little one and talk about how helping friends makes everyone happy! #Bedtime01Fables #OliverFox #KidsFriendship #TeamworkFun #WonderwoodValley

Join Oliver and Pip in Blossom Meadow for a tale of cooperation and kindness!
